title: SREV-036 conf user name wire

audit_contract.description: API: Conf_Api_SetUserName / API_SET_USER_NAME | wire: {"request": "API_SET_USER_NAME_ARGS", "fields": [{"name": "sidstring", "type": "UNICODE_STRING64*", "unit": "bytes", "nul_terminated": false}, {"name": "username", "type": "UNICODE_STRING64*", "unit": "bytes", "nul_terminated": false}]}

validation_invariants.description: All contracts listed in the contracts metadata must hold before any data is trusted past the validation boundary

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate proves contracts hold under normal and malformed inputs

contracts: UNICODE_STRING64.Length is a byte count and must be aligned to sizeof(WCHAR)
UNICODE_STRING64.Length must be nonzero, <= 1024, and <= MaximumLength
sidstring and username are counted strings; embedded NUL is invalid before CONF_USER C-string storage is derived
CONF_USER.sid_len and CONF_USER.name_len are WCHAR counts derived from the validated byte counts
CONF_USER.name storage starts after the full counted sidstring plus one local trailing NUL
the service-side sender validates sidstring as a string SID before calling SbieApi_SetUserName
